245:   def pbSymbiosis
246:     return if fainted?
247:     return if self.item
248:     @battle.pbPriority(true).each do |b|
249:       next if b.opposes?(self)
250:       next if !b.hasActiveAbility?(:SYMBIOSIS)
251:       next if !b.item || b.unlosableItem?(b.item)
252:       next if unlosableItem?(b.item)
253:       @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(b)
254:       if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
255:         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} shared its {2} with {3}!",
256:                                 b.pbThis, b.itemName, pbThis(true)))
257:       else
258:         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} let it share its {3} with {4}!",
259:                                 b.pbThis, b.abilityName, b.itemName, pbThis(true)))
260:       end
261:       self.item = b.item
262:       b.item = nil
263:       b.effects[PBEffects::Unburden] = true if b.hasActiveAbility?(:UNBURDEN)
264:       @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(b)
265:       pbHeldItemTriggerCheck
266:       break
267:     end
268:   end

270:   # item_to_use is an item ID or GameData::Item object. own_item is whether the
271:   # item is held by self. fling is for Fling only.
272:   def pbHeldItemTriggered(item_to_use, own_item = true, fling = false)
273:     # Cheek Pouch
274:     if hasActiveAbility?(:CHEEKPOUCH) && GameData::Item.get(item_to_use).is_berry? && canHeal?
275:       @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(self)
276:       pbRecoverHP(@totalhp / 3)
277:       if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
278:         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s HP was restored.", pbThis))
279:       else
280:         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} restored its HP.", pbThis, abilityName))
281:       end
282:       @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(self)
283:     end
284:     pbConsumeItem if own_item
285:     pbSymbiosis if !own_item && !fling   # Bug Bite/Pluck users trigger Symbiosis
286:   end

288:   #=============================================================================
289:   # Held item trigger checks
290:   #=============================================================================
291:   # NOTE: A Pokémon using Bug Bite/Pluck, and a Pokémon having an item thrown at
292:   #       it via Fling, will gain the effect of the item even if the Pokémon is
293:   #       affected by item-negating effects.
294:   # item_to_use is an item ID for Stuff Cheeks, Teatime, Bug Bite/Pluck and
295:   # Fling, and nil otherwise.
296:   # fling is for Fling only.
297:   def pbHeldItemTriggerCheck(item_to_use = nil, fling = false)
298:     return if fainted?
299:     return if !item_to_use && !itemActive?
300:     pbItemHPHealCheck(item_to_use, fling)
301:     pbItemStatusCureCheck(item_to_use, fling)
302:     pbItemEndOfMoveCheck(item_to_use, fling)
303:     # For Enigma Berry, Kee Berry and Maranga Berry, which have their effects
304:     # when forcibly consumed by Pluck/Fling.
305:     if item_to_use
306:       itm = item_to_use || self.item
307:       if Battle::ItemEffects.triggerOnBeingHitPositiveBerry(itm, self, @battle, true)
308:         pbHeldItemTriggered(itm, false, fling)
309:       end
310:     end
311:   end
312: 
313:   # item_to_use is an item ID for Bug Bite/Pluck and Fling, and nil otherwise.
314:   # fling is for Fling only.
315:   def pbItemHPHealCheck(item_to_use = nil, fling = false)
316:     return if !item_to_use && !itemActive?
317:     itm = item_to_use || self.item
318:     if Battle::ItemEffects.triggerHPHeal(itm, self, @battle, !item_to_use.nil?)
319:       pbHeldItemTriggered(itm, item_to_use.nil?, fling)
320:     elsif !item_to_use
321:       pbItemTerrainStatBoostCheck
322:     end
323:   end

325:   # Cures status conditions, confusion, infatuation and the other effects cured
326:   # by Mental Herb.
327:   # item_to_use is an item ID for Bug Bite/Pluck and Fling, and nil otherwise.
328:   # fling is for Fling only.
329:   def pbItemStatusCureCheck(item_to_use = nil, fling = false)
330:     return if fainted?
331:     return if !item_to_use && !itemActive?
332:     itm = item_to_use || self.item
333:     if Battle::ItemEffects.triggerStatusCure(itm, self, @battle, !item_to_use.nil?)
334:       pbHeldItemTriggered(itm, item_to_use.nil?, fling)
335:     end
336:   end

338:   # Called at the end of using a move.
339:   # item_to_use is an item ID for Bug Bite/Pluck and Fling, and nil otherwise.
340:   # fling is for Fling only.
341:   def pbItemEndOfMoveCheck(item_to_use = nil, fling = false)
342:     return if fainted?
343:     return if !item_to_use && !itemActive?
344:     itm = item_to_use || self.item
345:     if Battle::ItemEffects.triggerOnEndOfUsingMove(itm, self, @battle, !item_to_use.nil?)
346:       pbHeldItemTriggered(itm, item_to_use.nil?, fling)
347:     elsif Battle::ItemEffects.triggerOnEndOfUsingMoveStatRestore(itm, self, @battle, !item_to_use.nil?)
348:       pbHeldItemTriggered(itm, item_to_use.nil?, fling)
349:     end
350:   end

352:   # Used for White Herb (restore lowered stats). Only called by Moody and Sticky
353:   # Web, as all other stat reduction happens because of/during move usage and
354:   # this handler is also called at the end of each move's usage.
355:   # item_to_use is an item ID for Bug Bite/Pluck and Fling, and nil otherwise.
356:   # fling is for Fling only.
357:   def pbItemStatRestoreCheck(item_to_use = nil, fling = false)
358:     return if fainted?
359:     return if !item_to_use && !itemActive?
360:     itm = item_to_use || self.item
361:     if Battle::ItemEffects.triggerOnEndOfUsingMoveStatRestore(itm, self, @battle, !item_to_use.nil?)
362:       pbHeldItemTriggered(itm, item_to_use.nil?, fling)
363:     end
364:   end

366:   # Called when the battle terrain changes and when a Pokémon loses HP.
367:   def pbItemTerrainStatBoostCheck
368:     return if !itemActive?
369:     if Battle::ItemEffects.triggerTerrainStatBoost(self.item, self, @battle)
370:       pbHeldItemTriggered(self.item)
371:     end
372:   end

374:   # Used for Adrenaline Orb. Called when Intimidate is triggered (even if
375:   # Intimidate has no effect on the Pokémon).
376:   def pbItemOnIntimidatedCheck
377:     return if !itemActive?
378:     if Battle::ItemEffects.triggerOnIntimidated(self.item, self, @battle)
379:       pbHeldItemTriggered(self.item)
380:     end

383:   # Used for Eject Pack. Returns whether self has switched out.
384:   def pbItemOnStatDropped(move_user = nil)
385:     return false if !@statsDropped
386:     return false if !itemActive?
387:     return Battle::ItemEffects.triggerOnStatLoss(self.item, self, move_user, @battle)

399:   def pbConfusionBerry(item_to_use, forced, confuse_stat, confuse_msg)
400:     return false if !forced && !canHeal?
401:     return false if !forced && !canConsumePinchBerry?(Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 7)
402:     used_item_name = GameData::Item.get(item_to_use).name
403:     fraction_to_heal = 8   # Gens 6 and lower
404:     if Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION == 7
405:       fraction_to_heal = 2
406:     elsif Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 8
407:       fraction_to_heal = 3
408:     end
409:     amt = @totalhp / fraction_to_heal
410:     ripening = false
411:     if hasActiveAbility?(:RIPEN)
412:       @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(self, forced)
413:       amt *= 2
414:       ripening = true
415:     end
416:     @battle.pbCommonAnimation("EatBerry", self) if !forced
417:     @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(self) if ripening
418:     amt = pbRecoverHP(amt)
419:     if amt > 0
420:       if forced
421:         PBDebug.log("[Item triggered] Forced consuming of #{used_item_name}")
422:         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s HP was restored.", pbThis))
423:       else
424:         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} restored its health using its {2}!", pbThis, used_item_name))
425:       end
426:     end
427:     if self.nature.stat_changes.any? { |val| val[0] == confuse_stat && val[1] < 0 }
428:       @battle.pbDisplay(confuse_msg)
429:       pbConfuse if pbCanConfuseSelf?(false)
430:     end
431:     return true
432:   end

434:   def pbStatIncreasingBerry(item_to_use, forced, stat, increment = 1)
435:     return false if !forced && !canConsumePinchBerry?
436:     return false if !pbCanRaiseStatStage?(stat, self)
437:     used_item_name = GameData::Item.get(item_to_use).name
438:     ripening = false
439:     if hasActiveAbility?(:RIPEN)
440:       @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(self, forced)
441:       increment *= 2
442:       ripening = true
443:     end
444:     @battle.pbCommonAnimation("EatBerry", self) if !forced
445:     @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(self) if ripening
446:     return pbRaiseStatStageByCause(stat, increment, self, used_item_name) if !forced
447:     PBDebug.log("[Item triggered] Forced consuming of #{used_item_name}")
448:     return pbRaiseStatStage(stat, increment, self)
449:   end

451:   def pbMoveTypeWeakeningBerry(berry_type, move_type, mults)
452:     return if move_type != berry_type
453:     return if !Effectiveness.super_effective?(@damageState.typeMod) && move_type != :NORMAL
454:     mults[:final_damage_multiplier] /= 2
455:     @damageState.berryWeakened = true
456:     ripening = false
457:     if hasActiveAbility?(:RIPEN)
458:       @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(self)
459:       mults[:final_damage_multiplier] /= 2
460:       ripening = true
461:     end
462:     @battle.pbCommonAnimation("EatBerry", self)
463:     @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(self) if ripening
464:   end

466:   def pbMoveTypePoweringUpGem(gem_type, move, move_type, mults)
467:     return if move.is_a?(Battle::Move::PledgeMove)   # Pledge moves never consume Gems
468:     return if move_type != gem_type
469:     @effects[PBEffects::GemConsumed] = @item_id
470:     if Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6
471:       mults[:power_multiplier] *= 1.3
472:     else
473:       mults[:power_multiplier] *= 1.5
474:     end
475:   end
